jobs.description:
Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Responsibilities:   

 
•  
You support the development, optimization and management of technical products and solutions.
 
 
•  
You apply standards, guidelines and certification requirements, and support approval processes.
 
 
•  
You work closely with customers and translate their needs into technical solutions.
 
 
•  
You create and modify technical designs in CAD and manage the associated product data.
 
 
•  
You collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Production and Quality to address technical questions and challenges.
 
  
Required qualifications:   

 
•  
Higher education degree in Electromechanics, supplemented with initial work experience.
 
 
•  
Practical knowledge of 3D CAD and MS Office.
 
 
•  
Strong motivation and willingness to deepen your knowledge of standards, regulations and certifications.
 
 
•  
Willingness to travel within Europe and the US.
 
 
•  
Analytical mindset and ability to critically assess technical data.
 
 
•  
Strong interpersonal skills and a good command of English.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:
You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights
?? At least a high school diploma
?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail
?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work
?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

For a growing technical organization in the logistics sector, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician who wants to contribute to the reliability and efficiency of industrial installations. As a Maintenance Technician, under the supervision of a supervisor, you will be responsible for the proper functioning of automated sorting systems and conveyor lines. 

Your responsibilities include: 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance according to the CMMS plan (Computerized Maintenance Management System). 
 
•  
Quickly and efficiently detecting and resolving technical faults. 

 
•  
Making technical improvement proposals based on your experience with breakdowns. 

 
• Advising your supervisor on technical optimizations. 
 
•  
Preparing intervention reports and correctly registering activities in the CMMS system. 

 
•  
Managing stock and following up on spare parts. 

 
•  
Training and supporting users in carrying out first-line maintenance. 

 
• Providing technical support to the operational teams. 

In the long term, you will also work in the Vilvoorde region.

 
• You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) or Bachelor's degree in electromechanics, industrial electricity, or automation. 
 

 
• You have broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, automation, and pneumatics. 
 

 
• You have experience with industrial IT and CMMS systems. 
 
•  
Knowledge of sorting systems or conveyor systems is a plus. 

 
• You are fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

Security Cloud Architect | AWS | CISO Office

Are you passionate about securing large-scale cloud environments and driving security by design? We are looking for a Security Cloud Architect to join the CISO Office and play a key role in shaping and governing cloud security across the organisation's cloud transformation journey.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor and technical authority on cloud security, helping engineering teams build secure solutions while ensuring security risks are effectively managed. You will define cloud security standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and reusable security patterns, with a strong focus on AWS and exposure to Azure environments.

You will be responsible for reviewing and challenging solution designs, conducting threat modelling and architecture risk assessments, defining remediation plans, and ensuring security controls are aligned with business and regulatory requirements. Working closely with architects, engineers, security operations, and risk teams, you will help strengthen cloud security capabilities across the organisation.

We're looking for an experienced cloud security professional with a strong background in AWS security architecture, including IAM, network security, container security (EKS/ECS), DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), cryptography, logging and monitoring, and AWS security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, WAF, and KMS.

Key requirements

 
• 10+ years of experience in IT and Cybersecurity

 
• 5+ years of hands-on Cloud Security Architecture experience

 
• Strong expertise in AWS security architecture (Azure is a plus)

 
• Experience defining Cloud Security Control Frameworks and security standards

 
• Proven experience with threat modelling, security assessments, and risk management

 
• Knowledge of NIS2, ISO 27001, CIS, and NIST frameworks

 
• AWS Security Specialty certification is highly desirable

 
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

 
• Fluent English

 

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior cloud security expert who enjoys combining strategic architecture, governance, and hands-on technical security expertise in a modern cloud-first environment.

To find out more about Computer Futures please visit www.computerfutures.com

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

For a customer in Peer we are looking for motivated employees in dayshift.

Do you have a good feeling for fashion? Are you available in dayshift? You are not allergic for dust? 

 

As sorting emplyee you have the following tasks:

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You sort the clothing based on size, quality and fashion

• You quality check the clothing

• You start with the simpeler tasks and gradually the difficulty will improve

• Keeping the work environment tight and clean

As sorting employee we are looking for this profile:

• No experience required, everything can be learned

• You dont have dust allergy

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You speak Dutch or English well.

• You are results-driven, stress-resistant, and flexible.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.
